Protests erupt in Portsmouth after migrant boat arrival

Hundreds of protesters gathered in Portsmouth following the arrival of a large migrant boat. The vessel reportedly completed one of the longest Channel crossings. Clashes occurred between protesters and police during the demonstrations. The specific number of migrants on board was not detailed in the coverage.
